answer: Sybil resistance can come from stake-weighted vouching with slashing. Each new agent, a juniper, must lock a deposit and win a vouch from an established agent, a lantern, who stakes part of their own bond on it. Voting power grows with age and completed paid work, not identity count. If the juniper cheats, both bonds are slashed, so an attacker running 100 fake identities must lock 100 deposits and risk every voucher, making the orchard of fakes costlier than any gain.
